steps.name: apply-rerank-locality-snapshot-signature
args: BEGIN; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS ec_spire_index_scan_rerank_locality_snapshot(oid, real[]); CREATE FUNCTION ec_spire_index_scan_rerank_locality_snapshot(index_oid oid, query real[]) RETURNS TABLE (active_epoch bigint, effective_nprobe bigint, effective_nprobe_source text, effective_rerank_width bigint, effective_rerank_width_source text, candidate_count bigint, rerank_prefix_count bigint, unique_heap_block_count bigint, heap_block_transition_count bigint, heap_block_span bigint, heap_block_jump_sum bigint, heap_block_jump_max bigint) STRICT STABLE LANGUAGE c AS '$libdir/ecaz', 'ec_spire_index_scan_rerank_locality_snapshot_wrapper'; ALTER EXTENSION ecaz ADD FUNCTION ec_spire_index_scan_rerank_locality_snapshot(oid, real[]); COMMIT;

steps.name: precheck-aws-1m-rerank-locality-surface
args: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ecaz; SELECT now() AS captured_at, current_database() AS database_name, version() AS postgres_version; SELECT count(*) AS corpus_rows FROM task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_corpus; SELECT count(*) AS query_rows FROM task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_queries; SELECT i.relname AS index_name, am.amname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.oid)) AS index_size, i.reloptions FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam WHERE t.relname = 'task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_corpus' AND i.relname IN ('aws_spire_1m_rabitq_t85_v5_block16_tg256_idx') ORDER BY i.relname; SELECT p.oid::regprocedure AS rerank_locality_function FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'ec_spire_index_scan_rerank_locality_snapshot' ORDER BY 1; SELECT candidate_count, rerank_prefix_count, unique_heap_block_count, heap_block_transition_count, heap_block_span, heap_block_jump_sum, heap_block_jump_max FROM ec_spire_index_scan_rerank_locality_snapshot('aws_spire_1m_rabitq_t85_v5_block16_tg256_idx'::regclass::oid, (SELECT source FROM task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_queries ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)::real[]); SELECT name, setting, context FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('ec_spire.leaf_block_rows', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_summary_representatives', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_blocks_per_leaf', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_global_blocks', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_global_probe_blocks', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_rows_per_block', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_summary_prior_weight', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_summary_radius_weight', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_route_prior_weight', 'ec_spire.max_routing_expansions', 'ec_spire.nprobe', 'ec_spire.rerank_width') ORDER BY name;
